Hello,

I would like to know what the vaccination requirements are for animals in France.

Why vaccinate dead fish entering French territory? Why vaccinate ducks and all livestock?

Do you believe you have an ethical approach to this questionable practice in this very disturbing world?

What laws or decrees authorize you to do this?

Do you think the warnings from the president of the CNRS are unreasonable?

Please answer me directly!

What will your reactions be when the evidence of the dangers of these vaccines is revealed?

Have you considered the lawsuits and compensation that will come for all the victims of these mistakes?

A Frenchman asking the right questions!

Pascal Chéron
It's impossible to get through to a real person on the phone... You're supposed to support us, considering the price we pay for our membership fees!!! It's a disgrace
